priority_definitions.P0: Release blocker: exploitable security, data integrity or cross-request isolation defect
priority_definitions.P1: Required before client UAT: correctness, resilience, production integration and observability
priority_definitions.P2: Required before production launch: evals, UX, operations, cost and governance

release_gates: All P0 tasks completed and independently reviewed
Authentication, authorization and tenant-isolation security tests pass
Concurrent booking and idempotency tests pass on PostgreSQL
Direct and indirect prompt-injection evals pass agreed thresholds
PostgreSQL, Redis and Qdrant integration suite passes in CI
No critical/high known vulnerability remains open
Client UAT and production readiness checklists are signed

tasks.title: Add authentication, roles and tenant isolation
changes: Add users/tenants/memberships or an external identity-provider integration
Add tenant_id to lead, conversation, message, event, meeting and knowledge metadata
Require authenticated principals for all non-health routes
Separate public chat permissions from operator/admin CRM permissions
Filter every repository query by server-derived tenant_id and ownership
acceptance_criteria: Anonymous access to leads, events and conversations returns 401
Cross-tenant lead/conversation access returns 404 or 403 without revealing existence
Public chat cannot enumerate or patch CRM records
Tenant ID cannot be overridden by request or LLM tool arguments
verification: Security tests for IDOR, enumeration and tenant crossing
Repository tests proving mandatory tenant filters

tasks.title: Replace generic writes with typed, allowlisted commands
changes: Replace LeadUpdateRequest.fields with role-specific Pydantic models
Create separate qualification, operator and system update commands
Reject immutable/internal fields such as id, tenant_id, score, status and timestamps
Make memory_updates a typed qualification-fields model
Always overwrite lead_id/conversation_id/tenant_id with server context
acceptance_criteria: Unknown or internal update fields return 422
LLM cannot change score, status, ownership, IDs or timestamps directly
Every write command has explicit field-level authorization
verification: Schema tests for all allowed and forbidden fields

tasks.title: Make tool context request-scoped and concurrency-safe
changes: Remove mutable ToolContext from the SalesAgent singleton
Construct ToolContext inside each handle invocation
Pass session/principal/tenant as immutable request-scoped dependencies
Prevent SQLAlchemy objects from crossing sessions
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent requests never share AsyncSession or transaction state
SalesAgent singleton contains only stateless/thread-safe dependencies
verification: Concurrent /chat stress test with multiple tenants
Instrumentation asserting unique session identity per request

tasks.title: Enforce deterministic stage and qualification policy
changes: Treat LLM stage/meeting flags as proposals only
Calculate allowed transition from verified fields and scoring policy
Require score threshold, authority, contact data and explicit meeting consent
Remove direct forward jumps to meeting_booked
Transition to meeting_booked only from a verified booking result
acceptance_criteria: A low-score or incomplete lead cannot invoke booking
Failed tools cannot advance the funnel
State transitions are deterministic and unit-tested
verification: Policy table tests for every state transition
Booking failure leaves lead in meeting_proposed or qualified

tasks.title: Make write tools transactional, idempotent and result-verified
changes: Use typed ToolSuccess/ToolFailure envelopes
Use nested transactions/savepoints around tool writes
Rollback failed tool transactions before further DB use
Add request/action idempotency keys
Persist a pending action with exact parameters before external writes
Generate response from verified tool results, never an optimistic draft
acceptance_criteria: Repeated booking/update requests execute once
Tool failure never returns a success claim
Database and CRM state remain consistent after partial failures

tasks.title: Add atomic calendar overlap and offered-slot enforcement
changes: Model meetings as start/end intervals
Add PostgreSQL exclusion or equivalent conflict constraint
Validate future time, timezone, business hours and duration
Require a non-expired offered-slot/pending-action token
Flush meeting before writing its ID into audit events
acceptance_criteria: Overlapping and concurrent bookings cannot both commit
Unseen, expired, past or out-of-hours slots are rejected
Audit event always contains the persisted meeting ID

tasks.title: Establish prompt-injection trust boundaries
changes: Keep user, lead, RAG and tool content in explicitly delimited untrusted-data blocks
Add policy that retrieved/user content cannot redefine system rules or tool permissions
Sanitize and validate knowledge provenance
Never authorize an action from model text alone
Refuse system-prompt/key disclosure requests
acceptance_criteria: Direct and stored injections cannot change tenant, target lead, permissions or policy
Indirect RAG injection cannot trigger write tools
System prompt and secrets are not disclosed

tasks.title: Remove stored XSS and add browser security controls
changes: Replace lead-table innerHTML interpolation with DOM nodes and textContent
Add CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, frame restrictions and Referrer-Policy
Add safe URL handling and output encoding rules
acceptance_criteria: HTML/JS payloads render as text in all views
CSP blocks inline script execution

tasks.title: Secure Docker networking and secrets
changes: Remove host port publication for PostgreSQL, Redis and Qdrant
Replace default credentials with secret references
Enable Redis ACL/auth and Qdrant API key
Pin all image versions
Run backend as non-root on a read-only filesystem where feasible
acceptance_criteria: Only ingress/backend port is externally reachable
No default credential appears in deployment manifests
Containers run with minimum capabilities and pinned images

tasks.title: Add API limits, timeouts and abuse protection
changes: Bound message/conversation/pagination/date-range/duration/top_k values
Add per-IP, per-user and per-tenant rate limits
Add LLM, RAG, tool and total-request timeouts
Add max turns, max tool calls and per-run token/cost budget
Add repeated-identical-call detection
acceptance_criteria: Oversized requests fail with 422 or 413
Rate exhaustion returns 429
Timed-out operations terminate without side effects
A run cannot exceed configured cost/tool/turn limits

tasks.title: Reconcile ORM, migrations and integrity constraints
changes: Choose one canonical Lead-Conversation relationship
Add corrective Alembic migration
Add indexes for tenant/email/phone/events/messages/meetings
Add check constraints for score, volume, status and duration
Add Alembic metadata-drift verification
acceptance_criteria: Alembic schema equals SQLAlchemy metadata
Referential integrity prevents inconsistent conversation links
Required indexes and checks exist in PostgreSQL

tasks.title: Create mandatory security regression suite
changes: Add auth/authz/IDOR/tenant-crossing tests
Add mass-assignment and tool-scope tests
Add prompt-injection and secret-extraction tests
Add XSS/security-header tests
Add idempotency, race and unauthorized-write tests
acceptance_criteria: All previously documented critical attacks are blocked by automated tests
Security suite runs without production credentials
verification: CI security test job is required for merge
Independent review of negative test coverage

tasks.title: Implement strict structured-output contracts
acceptance_criteria: Provider-native strict schema is used where available
Validation errors trigger bounded repair/retry
Cross-field validators reject unsafe decisions

tasks.title: Fix provider adapters and fallback behavior
acceptance_criteria: OpenAI and Anthropic contract tests pass with provider-specific models/messages
Missing/unavailable provider enters a tested safe fallback without startup failure

tasks.title: Repair RAG lifecycle and grounding controls
acceptance_criteria: Keyword fallback uses the same ingested store instance
Qdrant uses valid deterministic UUID/integer IDs and idempotent upserts
Retrieval enforces relevance/context limits and verified source metadata
No-result behavior refuses unsupported factual claims

tasks.title: Harden memory and durable recovery
acceptance_criteria: Redis operation failures fall back safely and reconnect
PostgreSQL history restores context after Redis loss/restart
Memory has source/timestamp/type and tenant-bound deletion/retention

tasks.title: Add persistent tool-call audit and request tracing
acceptance_criteria: Every run/request/tool call has correlated IDs and duration
Tool args/results are redacted and persisted with status/error category
Sequence can be reconstructed without private chain-of-thought

tasks.title: Implement liveness, readiness and safe error envelopes
acceptance_criteria: Liveness checks process only
Readiness checks PostgreSQL and critical configured dependencies
Unavailable service returns 503 and stable request_id error envelope
Stack traces/raw provider or DB details never reach clients

tasks.title: Add production dependency integration suite
acceptance_criteria: CI tests PostgreSQL, Redis and Qdrant
Sandbox tests cover configured real LLM providers
Outage, timeout and malformed-result cases pass

tasks.title: Create CI quality and security gates
acceptance_criteria: PR workflow runs lint, format, type check, tests, Alembic check, secret/dependency/container scans
Production branch is protected and failed gates block merge

tasks.title: Align knowledge-base claims with implemented controls
acceptance_criteria: RBAC, encryption, retention and handoff statements are either implemented/evidenced or removed
Each KB document has owner, version and review date

tasks.title: Version and constrain the public API
acceptance_criteria: Business endpoints are under /api/v1
Typed request/response/error models and correct 401/403/404/409/422/429/503 codes are documented
CORS and CSRF policy matches the authentication mechanism

phases.name: Production readiness, evals and client handover

tasks.title: Create business requirements and KPI baseline
acceptance_criteria: Named owners approve current/future workflow, volumes, error cost, refusal/escalation rules, KPI targets and per-scenario DoD/DoF

tasks.title: Build an eval dataset and regression harness
acceptance_criteria: Dataset covers happy, ambiguous, contradictory, long, multilingual, tool failure, DB failure, RAG, injection, unauthorized and escalation cases
Metrics track task success, tool selection/args, schema validity, groundedness, unsafe actions, latency and cost

tasks.title: Implement human approval and escalation
acceptance_criteria: Approve/Reject/Modify/Escalate are persisted and tenant-bound
Parameter changes invalidate previous approval
Rejected actions cannot be executed through another tool

tasks.title: Add cost and latency budgets
acceptance_criteria: Cost per run/100 runs/month is documented
Token/tool/storage budgets and alerts are enforced
Latency SLOs and p50/p95/p99 dashboards exist

tasks.title: Complete frontend security, UX and accessibility
acceptance_criteria: Loading/error/duplicate-submit/history restore are implemented
Approval/escalation/source displays exist
Desktop/mobile and keyboard/accessibility tests pass

tasks.title: Create backup, restore, retention and deletion controls
acceptance_criteria: Encrypted off-host backups and Qdrant snapshots run on schedule
Restore is tested against documented RPO/RTO
Tenant/user deletion and retention jobs are audited

tasks.title: Create deployment, rollback and incident runbooks
acceptance_criteria: Staging and production are separated
HTTPS/domain/secrets/monitoring/alerts are configured
Rollback and incident response are rehearsed

tasks.title: Execute client UAT and handover
acceptance_criteria: Client executes at least three typical plus error/ambiguous/risky/outage/injection/unauthorized scenarios
Expected and actual results are recorded
Business, security, knowledge and production owners sign acceptance

tasks.title: Establish production quality dashboards
acceptance_criteria: Success, failure, tool failure, hallucination, escalation, latency, cost and complaints are monitored

tasks.title: Version prompts, models and knowledge releases
acceptance_criteria: Every prompt/model/KB change has version, owner, eval evidence and rollback path

tasks.title: Feed production incidents into evals
acceptance_criteria: Every confirmed production failure becomes a sanitized regression case

tasks.title: Review new tools before activation
acceptance_criteria: Every new tool has threat model, least-privilege scope, idempotency, tests and approval classification

known_limitations: P2/P3 items requiring client business decisions, signatures or production infrastructure are documented but not executed.
Real OAuth integrations, external webhooks and sandbox provider contracts require client credentials and separate integration tests.
PostgreSQL/Redis/Qdrant integration suite is configured in CI but not exercised here due to lack of local Docker.
mypy suppresses pre-existing type errors in app.services.llm, app.agent.schemas and app.rag.vector_store pending a dedicated typing refactor.
completion_summary.verification: 40 tests pass; ruff and mypy gates pass; security regression suite covers IDOR, mass-assignment, XSS and auth.
